solutions.title: Expand each start
solutions.strategy: For every left boundary, extend right while tracking the minimum height in that span.

timeComplexity.explanation: There are O(n^2) contiguous spans to evaluate.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Only the running minimum and best area are stored.

solutions.title: Monotonic stack
solutions.strategy: Maintain increasing bar indices; when a shorter bar appears, finalize rectangles for taller bars.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each bar is pushed and popped at most once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The stack can hold all increasing indices.
